raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "move"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "40 pallets with SKU HX-2210"
  role source "dock 3"
  role destination "the overflow in Ploiești"
  role time "Monday morning"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "remove"
  role subject "Costel"
  role object "12"
  role source "dock 3"
  role destination "Kaufland order"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "be on"
  role subject "pallets with SKU HX-2210"
  role location "dock 3"
  polarity affirmed
  basis closure

@q query
  select ?n
  where match
    relation "remain on"
    role subject "pallets with SKU HX-2210"
    role location "dock 3"
    polarity affirmed
  end
